title: DynaVest
tagline: DynaVest — your AI-powered gateway to seamless DeFi access.
description:
Introducing DynaVest, Your **DeFAI Agent** – an intelligent, fully autonomous system designed to execute, optimize, and adapt DeFi strategies based on your unique risk profile. With a user-friendly interface, it empowers you to interact effortlessly with DeFi protocols while staying up-to-date on the latest trends and insights in real time.

🔹 **What it does:**

**Automated Strategy Execution**

– No manual transactions required. Simply select your desired DeFi strategy, and DynaVest handles the rest.

**AI-Powered Guidance**

– Ask anything about our DeFi strategies. Your AI agent will explain the strategies, risks, and expected returns in real-time.

**Seamless Multicall3 Execution**

– Combines Morpho lending, EigenLayer restaking, and Uniswap liquidity across chains like Flow, Celo, Base, and Ethereum, consolidating them into a single, easy-to-use transaction.

🔹 **How it works:**

1️⃣ **Select your preferred DeFi strategy** (Low, Medium, or High risk), or let the AI guide you. It's simple to use.

2️⃣ **Ask any questions** related to these DeFi strategies. Get the latest information and receive real-time responses.

3️⃣ **Sign once**. Our DeFAI system takes care of the execution.

4️⃣ **Track and optimize** – The AI continuously adjusts strategies based on market conditions.

Built for both power users and DeFi newcomers, this is the next-generation way to deploy capital—smart, automated, and effortless.
how_its_made:
We have integrated Morpho, Flow staking, and Uniswap provide liquidity, leveraging **Multicall3** to streamline interactions with these protocols. **Multicall3** bundles multiple contract calls into a single transaction, optimizing gas efficiency and improving execution speed.

For this project, we’ve implemented some DeFi strategies mainly on Celo and Flow for demo, each with its own technical approach:

1️⃣ **AAVE** – Lending protocol on Celo. Allowing users to earn yield by supplying cEUR token

2️⃣ **KittyStable** – KittyStable is a Flow stablecoin exchange protocol that facilitates the trading of stablecoins. Users can earn fees by providing ankrFlow or Flow (increasing liquidity) on the platform.

3️⃣ **stCelo** – stCelo is a liquidity staking protocol on Celo that allows users to earn profits by staking CELO tokens and receiving stCelo as shares. Users can trade and redeem stCelo at any time

1️⃣ **Morpho** – Uses the `supply()` function to deposit assets into the Morpho market, allowing users to earn yield on their idle funds.

### **AI Agent Integration**

To enhance automation and data organization, we use multiple AI Agents working together:

1️⃣ **AI Agent Planner** – Organizes tasks efficiently.

2️⃣ **AI Agent Summarizer** – Aggregates and summarizes the latest DeFi news and yield farming information for users.

3️⃣ **AI Agent Organizer** – Utilizes RAG technology to retrieve relevant information from a **Qdrant Vector Database** and provide it to users.

### **AI RAG Implementation**

We embed data using **OpenAI’s `text-embedding-3-small`** model and store it in the **Qdrant Vector Database**. To retrieve relevant information, we use Faiss search to find the closest matching data points based on user input. The most relevant data chunks are then fed into an **LLM** to generate responses. Also we combine well-constructured AI Agent system so that users can easily get the latest DeFi yield farming information.

By integrating **Multicall3, AI Agents system, and RAG techniques**, we have built a **gas-efficient, user-friendly, and automated DeFi strategy execution system**.
